description:
Create an order for a user — the white-label path: your server sells from your app's own store with a store key (scope orders:write). The order locks the price, payees and a deadline (about 20 minutes) and carries `payment`: EVM {kind:'evm', chainId, checkout, order:{orderId, token, payees, amounts, deadline}, total, permit, calls?: [{to, data, value}] to send in order, permitTypedData?} or Solana {kind:'solana', cluster, transaction (base64 unsigned), reference, staticKey, memo}. The user's wallet pays; your client then posts the tx hash to /api/v2/iap/orders/{id}/submit, and the order turns confirmed at confirmation depth (poll iap_get_order or take the iap.order.confirmed webhook).

Params: store_id, sku, quantity?, wallet (the user's wallet; required with a store key), app_account_token? (your own account id, echoed in the receipt), session_token?, idempotency_key?
Returns: {ok, idempotency_key, order: Order}
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED (store not live), HTTP_400, HTTP_404 (sku), HTTP_409 (sold out / per-wallet cap / rule not met), PRICE_UNAVAILABLE (a dollar-priced SKU paid in the token or the coin whose live price cannot be read reliably right now — stale, still warming up, or moving more than 15%; retry in a minute). The order carries currency (address), currencyKind ('token'|'native'|'usdc'), currencySymbol and currencyDecimals; `amount` is the exact locked amount in that currency. Paid in the chain's coin, `calls` holds only the pay call with value = total, and permit is null. A dollar-priced order also carries priceUsdMicros and usdPerToken (the dollar price of one whole unit of the currency; 1 for usdc).

app_account_token.description: Your app's account id for the user; echoed in the receipt

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

wallet.description: User wallet that receives the items; required with a store key

name: iap_create_order
title: Create a store order
